messages:
mira: Quick design sync  I uploaded an iteration that renames the step to 'Connectivity check', adds a compact timeline bar showing probe durations, and exposes a one-click 'Download diagnostics bundle' + small quick-probe (443-only). Mock: https://www.figma.com/file/yzab5678/onprem-connectivity-v3 Can we check keyboard handoff, screen-reader wording (rotor behavior), and contrast for new timeline colors?
jamal: Timeline is helpful. Two issues: (1) when the timeline animates in it causes layout reflow; (2) keyboard users lose place when probe items collapse into the compact timeline. We'll need stable DOM and prefers-reduced-motion.
sophia: For screen readers the rotor picks up too many list items if each probe is a separate node. Suggest sr-only summary per card (e.g., "Connectivity check: 4 probes, 1 failed") and a single live region for updates. Avoid autofocus unless it's a blocking failure. Also TalkBack reads lengthy aria-labels oddly; keep labels concise.
alex: Implementation notes: use data-probe-id attributes and toggle classes instead of replacing nodes. For keyboard modality detection integrate the existing what-input hook so we only programmatically move focus for keyboard users. Small snippet:
```js
if(isKeyboardUser()) { summaryEl.setAttribute('tabindex','-1'); summaryEl.focus(); }
```
Also add prefers-reduced-motion query to skip timeline animation.
riley: Copy suggestions: change primary CTA to "Start connectivity check"; small action "Fix" -> "Open troubleshooting guide"; quick-probe button -> "Run quick check (443)". Fallback text should be explicit: "Connection timed out  try: 1) Run quick check 2) Download diagnostics 3) Verify outbound ports".
jamal: CSS: reserve space for timeline using min-height and animate transform/opacity instead of height. Also ensure the timeline color palette meets contrast when used as a thin bar. I'll push a patch.
sophia: I'll test with VoiceOver rotor, NVDA, and TalkBack tomorrow. Particular things to check: rotor grouping, live region verbosity, contrast for timeline and status chips, and focus return after closing logs.
alex: On errors mapping: for 504 show "Gateway timed out  try increasing probe timeout or run the quick check" and include a one-click quick check prefilled to 443. I'll add an entry in the probe-error map.
mira: Deploy preview then we can validate. Also change microcopy in Figma per Riley.
deploy-bot: preview build for branch connectivity-v3 is live: https://preview.redwood.com/branches/connectivity-v3  includes compact timeline, quick-probe, stable keys, and reduced-motion support. Please smoke test keyboard + VO.
jamal: Smoke-tested preview. Live region present and timeline respects reduced-motion. Found one keyboard flow: expanding the details via Enter moves focus to the first button but Escape doesn't return to the header. I'll PR a small focus-return on Escape.
riley: I'll update Figma and supply tooltip text for the timeline legend and the quick-probe, plus copy variants for user-testing.
sophia: Post my a11y pass I'll post a short checklist here with any regressions.
mira: Action items: jamal fix Escape focus return; alex add 504 mapping and quick-probe wiring; sophia run a11y pass; riley update Figma copy; I'll follow up on user-tests. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
mira: Closing thread, will reopen if a11y or user-tests surface blockers.
